1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Definitions
2 
3 /-! Ordinary Cartesian directions and determinants for the planar separation arguments. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
6 
7 open Real
8 
9 /-- The unit direction making angle `θ` with the positive horizontal axis. -/
10 noncomputable def direction (θ : ℝ) : Plane := !₂[cos θ, sin θ]
11 
12 /-- The signed area of the two planar vectors. -/
13 def det (x y : Plane) : ℝ := x 0 * y 1 - x 1 * y 0
14 
15 @[simp] theorem direction_x (θ : ℝ) : direction θ 0 = cos θ := rfl
16 @[simp] theorem direction_y (θ : ℝ) : direction θ 1 = sin θ := rfl
17 
18 theorem direction_norm (θ : ℝ) : ‖direction θ‖ = 1 := by
19   have square : ‖direction θ‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
20     rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
21     exact cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
22   nlinarith [norm_nonneg (direction θ)]
23 
24 theorem direction_ne_zero (θ : ℝ) : direction θ ≠ 0 := by
25   intro zero
26   have unit := direction_norm θ
27   simp [zero] at unit
28 
29 theorem direction_inner (α β : ℝ) : inner ℝ (direction α) (direction β) = cos (β - α) := by
30   simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, direction_x, direction_y, real_inner_eq_re_inner,
31     RCLike.inner_apply, RCLike.conj_to_real, RCLike.re_to_real, cos_sub]
32 
33 theorem direction_det (α β : ℝ) : det (direction α) (direction β) = sin (β - α) := by
34   simp only [det, direction_x, direction_y, sin_sub]
35   ring
36 
37 theorem direction_angle (α β : ℝ) (lower : 0 ≤ β - α) (upper : β - α ≤ π) :
38     InnerProductGeometry.angle (direction α) (direction β) = β - α := by
39   rw [InnerProductGeometry.angle, direction_inner, direction_norm, direction_norm, mul_one, div_one]
40   exact arccos_cos lower upper
41 
42 /-- Cartesian polar coordinates realize the cosine law exactly. -/
43 theorem polar_distance_sq (r s α β : ℝ) :
44     dist (r • direction α) (s • direction β) ^ 2 =
45       r ^ 2 + s ^ 2 - 2 * r * s * cos (β - α) := by
46   rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, direction_norm, direction_norm,
47     mul_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs,
48     real_inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, direction_inner]
49   ring
50 
51 theorem polar_radius (r θ : ℝ) (nonnegative : 0 ≤ r) : dist 0 (r • direction θ) = r := by
52   rw [dist_zero_left, norm_smul, direction_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg nonnegative]
53 
54 theorem det_add_right (x y z : Plane) : det x (y + z) = det x y + det x z := by
55   simp [det, PiLp.add_apply]
56   ring
57 
58 theorem det_sub_right (x y z : Plane) : det x (y - z) = det x y - det x z := by
59   simp [det, PiLp.sub_apply]
60   ring
61 
62 theorem det_smul_right (x y : Plane) (r : ℝ) : det x (r • y) = r * det x y := by
63   simp [det, PiLp.smul_apply]
64   ring
65 
66 /-- Signed area against a fixed direction is a continuous linear height. -/
67 noncomputable def detHeight (x : Plane) : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
68   x 0 • EuclideanSpace.proj 1 - x 1 • EuclideanSpace.proj 0
69 
70 @[simp] theorem detHeight_apply (x y : Plane) : detHeight x y = det x y := rfl
71 
72 theorem direction_height_surjective (θ : ℝ) : Function.Surjective (detHeight (direction θ)) := by
73   intro r
74   refine ⟨r • direction (θ + π / 2), ?_⟩
75   rw [detHeight_apply, det_smul_right, direction_det]
76   simp
77 
78 end SixVertexUnfolding
